column1: # Every row is a Go module path that is ALLOWED to be declared by more than
# one live go.mod, because every declarer is the SAME own-org submodule
# checked out at two (or three) locations: once directly under
# submodules/<name>/ (or constitution/), and once nested inside the
# submodules/claude-toolkit/** checkout (which vendors its own copies of the
# same own-org submodules). submodules/claude-toolkit is a submodule this
# project does NOT own and was explicitly instructed not to restructure or
# delete content from — the grandfather list is the correct scope per
# §11.4.124 (investigate before remove) + this finding's own instructions,
# mirroring the RS-13 pattern instead of masking the class with a blanket
# Grandfathered rows shrink ONLY (per §11.4.135 ratchet discipline): removing
# or de-duplicating a submodules/claude-toolkit/** copy removes its row (or
# its declarer) here; a NEW duplicate module path appearing anywhere else in
# the tree is NEVER covered by this list and MUST still fail
# `declarers` is the EXACT, ';'-separated, sorted set of go.mod paths
# (repo-relative) that are grandfathered for that module path. The gate
# compares the LIVE declarer set against this column: a live go.mod that
# declares a grandfathered module path but is NOT listed here is a NEW
# duplicate and FAILS the gate. (Round 2 keyed the allowlist by module path
# alone, so a THIRD copy of e.g. digital.vasic.containers planted anywhere
# live was silently absorbed as "grandfathered" — measured 2026-09-23,
